deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics. It is the printed title page (cover) of Dedekind's offprint 'Ueber den Zusammenhang zwischen der Theorie der Ideale und der Theorie der höheren Congruenzen'. The imprint reads: 'Aus dem dreiundzwanzigsten Bande der Abhandlungen der Königlichen Gesellschaft der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen', Göttingen, Dieterich'sche Verlags-Buchhandlung, 1878.

There are three handwritten additions:
- 'R. Dedekind.' at the top right.
- 'R. Dedekind. 1878.' at the bottom right.
- A pencil folio number '6' on a pasted repair strip at mid-page.

There are no derivations to reconstruct. In context, the previous page ends Dedekind's notes on Zolotarev's theory of ideal factors (dated 11 Aug 1876 and 24 Oct 1877). This offprint therefore sits in the bundle as Dedekind's own published answer to that topic.

The content of the printed paper, which is not shown on this page, is well known:
- Factoring a rational prime p in the ring of integers via factoring the minimal polynomial of a generator modulo p, valid when p does not divide the index.
- The theorem that p ramifies if and only if p divides the field discriminant.
- The treatment of 'common inessential discriminant divisors', including his cubic-field example.

None of this appears on the page itself.
